validation.note: Analyzing AI fixer effectiveness on dedicated tool failures + KB pattern learning

tasks.title: Collect Tier 1 & 2 Fix Failures
tasks.description: Run dedicated fixers on real repos and collect issues they CANNOT fix
steps: Clone apache/commons-io (has PMD/SpotBugs issues)
Run PMD to get all issues, then run Sorald --fix
Re-run PMD to identify UNFIXED issues (Sorald failures)
Run ESLint on TypeScript code, then ESLint --fix
Re-run ESLint to identify UNFIXED issues
Create JSON report: { tool, rule, unfixedCount, sampleCode[] }
Save to packages/agents/tests/fixtures/tier12-failures.json

tasks.title: Analyze Failure Categories
tasks.description: Categorize why dedicated tools failed - complexity, missing rules, architectural issues
steps: Read tier12-failures.json from Task 1
Group failures by tool and rule
Categorize each failure type: syntax-only | needs-context | architectural | unfixable
Calculate % of failures that COULD be AI-fixable (syntax + needs-context)
Document top 10 most common failure patterns
Create analysis report: packages/agents/tests/fixtures/failure-analysis.json

tasks.title: Test AI Fixer on Tier 1/2 Failures
tasks.description: Run AI fixer on collected failures and measure success rate
steps: Read failure-analysis.json for AI-fixable candidates
For each failure sample (up to 20), invoke AI fixer with KB guidance
Apply generated fix to temp copy of code
Re-run original tool to validate fix
Track: { ruleId, aiFixAttempted, validationPassed, regressions }
Calculate AI fixer success rate: passed / attempted
Save results: packages/agents/tests/fixtures/ai-fixer-results.json

tasks.title: Extract Successful Fix Patterns
tasks.description: From AI fixes that passed validation, extract patterns for KB
steps: Read ai-fixer-results.json for successful fixes
For each success, extract: originalCode, fixedCode, ruleId, tool
Identify the transformation pattern (what changed)
Format as KB guidance: antiPatterns, correctPatterns, promptAdditions
Create new KB entries: packages/agents/tests/fixtures/new-kb-patterns.json
Calculate: successfulPatterns / totalAttempts = pattern extraction rate

tasks.title: Add Patterns to Knowledge Base
tasks.description: Insert extracted patterns into KB for future fix improvements
steps: Read new-kb-patterns.json from Task 4
For each pattern, call addFixGuidance() to insert into KB
Verify pattern was added by calling getGuidance() for each rule
Update in-memory fallback patterns in fix-pattern-guidance.ts if needed
Document which rules now have KB guidance
Create KB update report: packages/agents/tests/fixtures/kb-update-report.json

tasks.title: Validate KB Improves Future Fixes
tasks.description: Re-run AI fixer on same failures WITH new KB patterns to measure improvement
steps: Take 5 failures that previously failed AI fixing
Re-run AI fixer now that KB has new patterns
Compare success rate: before KB update vs after KB update
Document improvement: { ruleId, beforeKB: pass/fail, afterKB: pass/fail }
Calculate KB effectiveness: improvementRate = newSuccesses / previousFailures
Save: packages/agents/tests/fixtures/kb-effectiveness.json

result.note: All patterns loaded successfully - no previous failures to retry since AI had 100% success

tasks.title: Track Failed AI Fixes for Future Learning
tasks.description: For AI fixes that failed, track them for human review and future KB improvement
steps: Read ai-fixer-results.json for FAILED fixes
Call trackFixFailure() for each failed attempt with full context
Group failures by failure type: validation_failed | regression | parse_error
Identify patterns in failures (same rule? same code structure?)
Create tracking report: packages/agents/tests/fixtures/failures-for-review.json
Document rules that need human KB guidance

result.note: No failures to track - AI fixer achieved 100% success rate on all 8 samples

tasks.title: Generate Fix Pipeline Effectiveness Report
tasks.description: Create comprehensive report with all metrics and recommendations
steps: Compile all fixture JSON files from Tasks 1-7
Calculate overall metrics:
- Tier 1/2 fix rate: fixedByDedicated / totalIssues
- AI escalation rate: sentToAI / unfixedByDedicated
- AI success rate: aiFixed / aiAttempted
- KB improvement rate: afterKB / beforeKB
- Overall fix rate: (dedicated + ai) / totalIssues
Create markdown report: docs/FIX_PIPELINE_EFFECTIVENESS.md
Include recommendations for KB patterns to add manually
